DT_BuildObjectDescText.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_PRF_EggResourceProcesso: 54 egg slots. Automatically incubates (+50% speed) and butchers Pals; materials drop in front for pickup or transport. Power: 200/s, 400/s while incubating. Pauses without power and resumes when restored. Deposited eggs cannot be retrieved; demolition destroys contents. No live Pals or Palbox slots required.
